verdict.rationale: Omarchy's docs say snapshots are created automatically on every Omarchy update, and users can make their own with `omarchy-snapshot create`. That is the core mechanism for recovering from a broken update, but the pack never shows how a rollback is actually performed. missing for 10: documented restore/rollback procedure (e.g., a boot-menu or CLI restore command), details of snapshot scope, independent or hands-on confirmation that rollback works.
